shellCommands.command: ls && cat package.json && ls app 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/ && grep -ril "after" node_modules/next/dist/docs/ | head -20
ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/ | grep -i after; cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/after.md; cat app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx
grep -A3 '"paths"' tsconfig.json; npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | tail -5 && echo TSC_OK; timeout 300 npx next build 2>&1 | tail -20

(PORT=3456 npx next start > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code} in %{time_total}s\n" -A "verify-agent" http://localhost:3456/; sleep 1; grep -A5 analytics /tmp/next.log; pkill -f "next start"; git status --short
